resources.recheck.title: Reads this host's CPU, memory and storage again now.
resources.capacity.title: Infrastructure capacity
resources.capacity.hint: What this host can give employees: its total, minus what Orbit, the database, the proxy and the system keep. Checked {when}. Re-check reads the host again now (after the server was resized, or its settings changed); a budget that follows the host's capacity follows it.
resources.accountBudget.title: Account budget
resources.now.title: Now
resources.now.overBudget: Over budget until running work ends: new work waits; nothing running is stopped.
resources.now.idleNote: An idle employee reserves no CPU or memory: it is reserved when its work starts, and released once its containers are gone.
resources.now.modelPlanePrefix: Each attempt also reserves its CLI's own container: {items}.
resources.now.reservedNote: Reserved is what admission holds for running work, not what it uses: what it uses is under Observed use.
resources.observed.title: Observed use
resources.observed.hint: What the running attempts' containers were last measured using — never what they reserved (Now, above), and never the storage committed (below).
resources.storage.title: Storage
resources.storage.summary: {committed} committed and {used} used, of a budget of {budget}. Measured {when}.
resources.storage.hint: Committed is what quotas promise (desks, caches, team rooms) and what admitted work holds for scratch; used is what was measured.

claudeConnectors.intro: A checked connector can be used by Claude as your Claude account -- it reads and writes in that service: in every chat, or in research sessions, where your sources are references Claude reads beside your question (check there only what you want research to act with, such as Claude Docs). Connectors are connected at claude.ai; one waiting for your sign-in there cannot be used until you do.
claudeConnectors.notRead: Not read from your Claude account
claudeConnectors.empty: Your Claude account has no connector.
connectors.github.expiredRest: {detail} Your chats are kept; connect again to continue.
connectors.github.switchLabel: Let Claude Code push and open pull requests with this GitHub sign-in
connectors.github.switchHintBeforeGh: Off, Claude Code commits in its workspace and you push. On, it may push branches and open pull requests with
connectors.github.switchHintMiddle: as this account in any chat (never a force-push or the default branch, by its instructions); the sign-in itself stays out of its reach (
connectors.github.switchHintAfterAuth: is refused). Turn it on only for repositories you trust.
connectors.github.cliHint: Uses GitHub CLI's own sign-in; no GitHub App and no personal access token. Disconnecting ends the CLI's sign-in in this container; to revoke the authorization itself, use GitHub's Settings → Applications.
connectors.azure.switchLabel: Let Claude Code use this Azure sign-in
connectors.azure.switchHintBefore: Lists and clones your Azure DevOps repositories with the Azure CLI's own sign-in, kept in this container. With the switch on, Claude Code may also run
connectors.azure.switchHintAfter: as this account in any chat — including against resources that matter — so turn it on only for accounts and repositories you trust.
